title: Trip lookup: open trip covers the identification
description: Covering-guard table row 1: end_date is null, an open trip covers the identification, link it. The trip is deliberately left open for this fixture (no IGN_OFF is ever sent); this case only exercises the lookup finding an open covering trip, not trip close. Must prove: the identification links to the open trip and both assignees become A. Must NOT change: nothing before the identification should touch the assignee (the checkpoint right after the trip starts is the negative control).
